description: Define the v0 data model for inventory-app. Must support at minimum: consumables (cleaning products, groceries, parts — tracked with approximate quantity), tools (owned once, tracked by category and identifier), assets (larger items with metadata — appliances, vehicles, electronics — with purchase-date optionality). Design for partial coverage (user does not have to inventory everything). Design read API around query shapes partner scenarios need (routines-app asks does user have X?). Defer auto-depletion, OCR, warranty tracking to v1+. Deliverable: data-model.md under the inventory-app initiative folder.
name: inventory-app-data-model
title: Design Inventory-App Data Model
